# MADFAM CV (working label) — ai-portfolio-builder, full context

> Last Updated: 2026-10-22. Canonical instructions: AGENTS.md. This file summarises it for LLM readers.

## Product

A job-specific CV and portfolio builder from Innovaciones MADFAM S.A.S. de C.V. (Cuernavaca, Morelos,
México). The owner requirement (docs/PRODUCT.md, verbatim there): take the applicant's core information once,
be fed a range of jobs, and produce a matching range of tailored CVs, portfolios and presentations, one per job.
Model: profiles (one per Janua sub) → profile_items (experience, education, skills, projects, ...) → jobs
(pasted postings) → artifacts (cv | portfolio | presentation | cover_letter, general or per job; private, link or
public). A deterministic, AI-free GET /api/v1/jobs/:id/match scores items against a posting. Status:
incubating, pre-launch; sign-in and data are built but dormant until provisioned. The brand is not ruled;
"MADFAM CV" is a working label rendered from one constant.

## What runs today (wave 1, the fresh baseline)

- cv.madfam.io: landing, es-MX at /, en at /en. Waitlist CTA is a mailto to hola@madfam.io (no form,
  cookie or analytics). noindex while CV_INDEXABLE is not "true". robots.txt allows the R40 AI crawlers
  (ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot,
  Applebot-Extended) and everyone else, so crawlers can see the noindex; the sitemap exists only when
  indexable.
- cv-app.madfam.io: the app shell (pre-launch notice while sign-in is not configured; then «Iniciar sesión»,
  account switching and RP-logout per R44, and «Mis portafolios»). Auth.js /api/auth/*, POST /auth/entrar,
  POST /auth/salir and the same-origin /api/v1/* proxy live on this host only. noindex; robots disallow all.
- cv-api.madfam.io: GET /api/v1/meta -> {name, service, version, revision, api}; the bearer-authenticated,
  owner-scoped API (docs/PRODUCT.md); JSON 404 elsewhere. noindex; robots disallow all.
- Any Host: GET /health (liveness, static) and GET /ready (readiness: valid configuration, plus a bounded
  select 1 once a database is configured). Any other path on an unknown Host: plain 404.
- Headers: per-request nonce CSP with 'strict-dynamic' on HTML (no 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval'
  for scripts), locked CSP elsewhere, HSTS, nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, Referrer-Policy,
  Permissions-Policy, COOP.

## Architecture

- pnpm workspace (pnpm 9.15.0 via corepack, lockfile v9), one app: apps/web (Next.js 16.4.2, React
  19.3.1, TypeScript 5.9.3, output standalone).
- src/proxy.ts (Next 16 Proxy, Node runtime) applies pure decisions from src/lib/routing.ts: probes
  first, then an exact Host match against the host table, then a per-role path allowlist rewritten to
  internal routes under /h/ (never public).
- src/instrumentation.ts validates the environment at boot and exits non-zero on a defect.
- Identity: Auth.js next-auth 5.0.0-beta.32 with the Janua OIDC provider (PKCE, state, nonce; host-only
  session cookie on cv-app); the API verifies Janua RS256 tokens of audience cv-api against the JWKS (jose;
  HS256 refused; JWKS unreachable -> 503).
- Data: Drizzle + postgres.js through PgBouncer (prepare false, pool 3 per pod); runtime role cv_app
  (APP_DATABASE_URL), migrations as the owner (DATABASE_URL) via a PreSync Job running the image with
  CV_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT=true.
- Tests: node:test over TypeScript (Node type stripping) in apps/web/test; a real-Postgres suite in
  apps/web/test-pg (run as cv_app); a smoke test over the built standalone server in apps/web/test-server.

## Deployment

Enclii project and Service `cv`, namespace `cv`. Root Dockerfile (node:22-alpine by digest, uid 1001,
read-only root). infra/k8s/production: Deployment (2 replicas, probes, enableServiceLinks false),
Service 80 -> 3000, PodDisruptionBudget, NetworkPolicies (tunnel ingress; DNS, 443 and PgBouncer egress),
kustomization with an all-zero digest placeholder that the first Build & Deploy run replaces.
Build & Deploy is dispatch-only and calls Enclii's reusable build-publish pinned by SHA on
GitHub-hosted runners. Not onboarded yet; steps in docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.

## Ecosystem

Consumes, never rebuilds: Janua (identity; janua.client.yaml: resource server cv-api,
confidential client cv-web with callback https://cv-app.madfam.io/api/auth/callback/janua), Enclii
(deploy, domains, secrets intake), Dhanam (money, later), Selva (LLM gateway, later), self-hosted
Plausible (analytics, later), Angelia (messaging, later), PhyndCRM (consent/attribution, later).

## Rules

- No invented users, metrics, logos or testimonials. Anything not built says "próximamente".
- Legal entity line: Innovaciones MADFAM S.A.S. de C.V. · Cuernavaca, Morelos, México.
- Mailboxes: hola@, privacy@, legal@, security@, support@madfam.io only. madfam.io is the only MADFAM
  domain; the .com of the same name belongs to a third party.
- Licence: code AGPL-3.0-only (owner confirms at merge of the baseline), docs MIT.
- The old implementation (git tag legacy-2025-09) is reference only; nothing is ported without being
  rebuilt to this tree's standard.
